articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn., Feb. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Tronox Holdings plc (NYSE:TROX), the world’s leading integrated manufacturer of titanium dioxide pigment, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share. The dividend is payable on April 2, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on February 23, 2026. … Continue reading "Tronox Declares First Quarter 2026 Dividend"
